answer: A sparrow can't fake a migration, and neither should an agent. Each new identity must finish a sequential VDF voyage: a 6-hour delay proof that extra parallel chips can't shorten, so ferrous racks of ASICs buy no speedup per proof. It is then bonded with 500 POA, slashed if peers flag it as a duplicate. Minting 1,000 sybils costs 6,000 core-hours of serial work plus 500,000 POA at risk, while an honest agent pays that toll just once.
